articles.summary: ("WhiteHorse Finance" or the "Company") (Nasdaq: WHF) today announced its financial results for the second quarter ended June 30, 2026. In addition, the Company's board of directors has declared a distribution of $0.25 per share with respect to the quarter ended June 30, 2026. The distribution will be payable on October 5, 2026 to stockholders of record as of September 21, 2026.
